title: Bird Box
author: Josh Malerman
summary: Something has appeared that drives people to violence the moment they see it. A mother and two children must make a blindfolded trip down a river, while the story flashes back to how she survived the early days.
readIf: you want a very quick, tense read built around one simple, frightening idea.
skipIf: you want an explanation of the threat or a lot of character depth.

pairings.reason: A far more literary and bleak tale of a parent protecting a child after collapse.
Another story about humans facing something they cannot understand and may not be able to perceive.
